title.en: Christmas fair at the Finnish church and in Finland

summary: Translation exercise set at a Christmas fair: 37 English sentences (asking for the toilet, ordering food and drinks, paying, Christmas items) to say in Finnish, with key vocabulary given in brackets.
transcript:
JOULUMYYJÄISET SUOMALAISELLA KIRKOLLA JA SUOMESSA

KUINKA SANOT SUOMEKSI:

0.  Excuse me, where is your toilet? (vessa)

1.  How much is the entrance fee? (sisäänpääsymaksu)

2.  weWdon´t have an entrance fee. This is a free event. (ilmainen; tapahtuma)

3.  Where are your shopping baskets and shopping trolleys? (ostoskori; ostoskärry)

4.  Where is your cafe?

5.  How about the grill? (grilli)

6.  Excuse me, is the grill open? (auki/ avoinna)

7.  Excuse me, is this seat free? (paikka; vapaa)

8.  No, it is taken. (varatttu)

9.  Are those three chairs taken? (tuoli)

10. Do you have any mustard or ketchup?

11. Do you have any vegetarian peasoup? (kasvishernekeitto)

12. Two vegetarian sausages and a glass of beer. (kasvis-)

13. I am a vegan. Is the mashed potato vegan? (vegaani; perunamuusi; vegaaninen)

14. Do you have any more ryebread? (any more/some more= lisää)

15. May I have some reindeer stew and some lingonberry jam? (May I have= Saanko?; poronkäristys; puolukkahillo)

16. May I have some more butter?

17. Two alcohol-free mulled wines, please. (alkoholiton; mulled wine= glögi)

18. Two alcoholic mulled wines please and two spoons. (terästetty)

19. Two black coffees, one hot chocolate and two Karelian pies.

20. Three warm Karelian pies, please.

21. One black tea, two coffees and some milk, please.

22. Do you have any soy milk? How about oat milk or almond milk? (soijamaito; kauramaito; mantelimaito)

23. Is this bun lactose free?

24. May I have a piece of that gluten-free blueberry pie, please?

25. Three cinnamon buns to go please. May I have two small paper bags, please? (mukaan; paperipussi)

26. Where are your tills? May I pay by contactless? I don´t have any cash. (kassa; lähimaksu; käteinen)

27. How much do the plastic bags cost? (muovikassi)

28. We are standing in the queue. (jono)

29. Will you pay these Christmas decorations? (joulukoriste)

30. Excuse me, where are the alcoholic drinks? (alkoholijuomat)

31. May I have a bottle of Kyrö Gin, please?

32. I will buy some Fazer milk chocolate and a couple of bags of licorice. (pari)

33. Excuse me, who is playing the piano and who is singing? (soittaa pianoa)

34. This advent calendar is expensive. (joulukalenteri; kallis)

35. Shall we buy five red candles and ten Christmas cards? (kynttilä; joulukortti)

36. Is your (plural ”you”) Christmas tree real or is it a plastic tree? (joulukuusi > ”kuusi”= spruce, a fir tree; oikea; muovi-)

words.en: to get, to receive; (saanko?) may I have?
